name: Krobu
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Kraffa, Désiré. 2022. Apprendre le krobou = Learn krobou. Côte d'Ivoire – Ivory Coast. Bilingue français-anglais. Paris: L'Harmattan. 182 pp. ISBN 978-2-343-25451-7.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bilingual phrasebook by a sociologist (publisher's free online extract, text layer pp. 1-179 downloaded from liseuse.harmattan.fr). Foreword pp. 17-18 says only that the orthography is 'à base phonologique … le krobou s'écrit comme on l'entend'; no chapter on pronunciation, tone or accent; a full-text search for stress/accent/ton(s)/tonal/prosod/intonation/stress gives no linguistic hit. Bibliography pp. 173-175 is ethnographic only.

sources.citation: Kraffa, Désiré. 2021. Guide de conversation français-krobou: Côte d'Ivoire. Paris: L'Harmattan. 117 pp. ISBN 978-2-343-23010-8.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Earlier version of the 2022 phrasebook; its 'notes de grammaire de base' could contain a pronunciation note; the publisher's online reader returned no stream URL this time. Very unlikely to state a stress rule.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en), 'Krobu language', raw wikitext downloaded 2026-09-17 (phonology tables cited to Hérault (ed.) 1983 Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire).
sources.note: Consonant and vowel inventories plus 'Krobu has seven tones; high, mid, low, rising, falling, low-rising, and low-falling' — second-hand from the Atlas chapter; nothing on stress or accent.

sources.citation: Mensah, Emmanuel N.A. 1983. Le Krobou. In Georges Hérault (ed.), Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire, tome 1: Monographies (2e éd.), 425-463. Abidjan: Institut de Linguistique Appliquée / Agence de Coopération Culturelle et Technique.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: held in print at Harvard (Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL8424.A85 1983); the library holds the journal volume but the item itself was not found; ask your own library for a scan or interlibrary loan
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL8424 .A85 1983
sources.note: The only descriptive (phonology + morphosyntax) sketch of Krobu; source of the 7-tone inventory quoted on Wikipedia; its 'Phonologie' section is where any statement on accent would be. Harvard holds it in print (Widener Library (offsite storage) PL8424.A85 1983, (a scan can be requested through your own library); HathiTrust uva.x000974809 is search-only.

sources.citation: Adekpate, Alain. 2016. Réflexions sur la construction du sens des locutions verbales du krobou. In A.-D. Lezou Koffi, A. Vahoua Kallet & A. E. Kra Kouakou (eds.), Cheminements linguistiques: Mélanges en hommage à N'Guessan Jérémie Kouadio, 99-114. Saarbrücken: Éditions Universitaires Européennes.

sources.access_detail: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Only other Glottolog-listed linguistic work on Krobu; semantics of verbal idioms, so a low chance of a stress remark, but its introduction may summarise the phonology.

sources.citation: Adekpate, Alain. 2011. La coordination et la subordination, deux types d'intégration propositionnelle en krobou, langue kwa de Côte d'Ivoire. Thèse de doctorat, Université de Cocody (Abidjan). 646 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Largest modern work on Krobu by a native-speaker linguist; Ivorian theses of this size normally open with a phonological sketch including tone and a remark on accent; would supersede the 1983 sketch. Not in any online catalogue reached (SUDOC, theses.fr, HAL, BnF, HathiTrust, the Harvard library catalogue).

sources.citation: Hérault, Georges (ed.). 1983. Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire, tome 2: Listes lexicales et études comparatives. Abidjan: ILA / ACCT.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: Companion volume with tone-marked Krobou wordlists and comparative notes; useful for checking whether any prosodic prominence is marked on Krobou forms, and the general phonological introduction may state the ILA position on accent in Ivorian Kwa.
